say:3:1523401002:1.text: Most of the councilmen have come around. Only Aurelin and a handful of his supporters are still holding out.
say:3:1523401002:1.source_cn: 大部分议事官都被比博老师说服了，只剩下奥勒留和几位追随...
say:3:1523401002:1.male: Most of the councilmen have come around. Only Aurelin and a handful of his supporters are still holding out.
say:3:1523401002:1.female: Most of the councilmen have come around. Only Aurelin and a handful of his supporters are still holding out.

say:4:1523401003:1.text: Master Bakis said... the seeds didn't turn out well, but he didn't tell me what went wrong.
say:4:1523401003:1.source_cn: 比博老师说……结果不太好。但他没有告诉我具体的情况。
say:4:1523401003:1.male: Master Bakis said... the seeds didn't turn out well, but he didn't tell me what went wrong.
say:4:1523401003:1.female: Master Bakis said... the seeds didn't turn out well, but he didn't tell me what went wrong.

say:5:1523401004:1.text: You might want to <style="highlight">take a look at the field</style> yourself.
say:5:1523401004:1.male: You might want to <style="highlight">take a look at the field</style> yourself.
say:5:1523401004:1.female: You might want to <style="highlight">take a look at the field</style> yourself.

choice:2:1:2.text: Have the bitter corn seeds sprouted?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 苦苞穗的种子能种出来吗？
choice:2:1:2.male: Have the bitter corn seeds sprouted?
choice:2:1:2.female: Have the bitter corn seeds sprouted?

say:6:1523401005:0.text: Master Bakis and Halia need your help!
say:6:1523401005:0.source_cn: 如果可以的话，请一定要帮帮比博老师和呼临城！
say:6:1523401005:0.male: Master Bakis and Halia need your help!
say:6:1523401005:0.female: Master Bakis and Halia need your help!

say:7:1523401006:0.text: Halia... and I are counting on you!
say:7:1523401006:0.source_cn: 呼临城……还有我，都仰仗你了！
say:7:1523401006:0.male: Halia... and I are counting on you!
say:7:1523401006:0.female: Halia... and I are counting on you!

choice:2:2:3.source_cn: 好吧，我去农田那里看看

say:1:1523403001:0.text: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm afraid I only have bad news for you.
say:1:1523403001:0.male: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm afraid I only have bad news for you.
say:1:1523403001:0.female: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm afraid I only have bad news for you.

choice_prompt:2:1523403001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你来了。但恐怕迎接你的不是一个好消息。
choice_prompt:2:1523403001.male: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm afraid I only have bad news for you.
choice_prompt:2:1523403001.female: There you are, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I'm afraid I only have bad news for you.

say:3:1523403002:1.text: The bitter corn seeds can bear grains, but that's about it.
say:3:1523403002:1.source_cn: 派翁改良的苦苞穗的确能结穗，但也仅此而已。
say:3:1523403002:1.male: The bitter corn seeds can bear grains, but that's about it.
say:3:1523403002:1.female: The bitter corn seeds can bear grains, but that's about it.

say:4:1523403003:1.text: Even with Paeon's modifications and the Tuttleton priests' blessings, the God of Harvest's curse remains too strong to overcome.
say:4:1523403003:1.source_cn: 虽说他改良了苦苞穗的产量，或许还有图塔镇祭司们施加的加...
say:4:1523403003:1.male: Even with Paeon's modifications and the Tuttleton priests' blessings, the God of Harvest's curse remains too strong to overcome.
say:4:1523403003:1.female: Even with Paeon's modifications and the Tuttleton priests' blessings, the God of Harvest's curse remains too strong to overcome.

say:5:1523403004:1.text: Its yield falls far below my expectations.
say:5:1523403004:1.source_cn: 苦苞穗的产量远不如我预期中那样丰厚，不过终究是能结出少...
say:5:1523403004:1.male: Its yield falls far below my expectations.
say:5:1523403004:1.female: Its yield falls far below my expectations.

say:6:1523403005:0.text: And there's one more major issue.
say:6:1523403005:0.source_cn: 此外，还有一个非常严重的问题。
say:6:1523403005:0.male: And there's one more major issue.
say:6:1523403005:0.female: And there's one more major issue.

say:9:1523403007:1.text: ... Let's just say it's barely edible.
say:9:1523403007:1.male: ... Let's just say it's barely edible.
say:9:1523403007:1.female: ... Let's just say it's barely edible.

say:10:1523403008:1.text: It might help with the famine for a while, but it's definitely not a reliable food source in the long run. No one could keep eating something that tastes so awful.
say:10:1523403008:1.source_cn: 苦苞穗或许可以短期缓解饥荒，但作为可靠的食物来源，它完...
say:10:1523403008:1.male: It might help with the famine for a while, but it's definitely not a reliable food source in the long run. No one could keep eating something that tastes so awful.
say:10:1523403008:1.female: It might help with the famine for a while, but it's definitely not a reliable food source in the long run. No one could keep eating something that tastes so awful.

say:11:1523403009:1.text: I've made bread with the bitter corn, and there's still some left. If you're curious, you can take a bite.
say:11:1523403009:1.source_cn: 用苦苞穗做成的面包还剩一些。如果好奇，你可以尝尝。
say:11:1523403009:1.male: I've made bread with the bitter corn, and there's still some left. If you're curious, you can take a bite.
say:11:1523403009:1.female: I've made bread with the bitter corn, and there's still some left. If you're curious, you can take a bite.

say:12:1523403010:1.text: As food, its only merits are that it's filling and non-toxic. Nothing more.
say:12:1523403010:1.source_cn: 作为食物来说，它的可取之处是无毒，以及能填饱肚子。仅此而已。
say:12:1523403010:1.male: As food, its only merits are that it's filling and non-toxic. Nothing more.
say:12:1523403010:1.female: As food, its only merits are that it's filling and non-toxic. Nothing more.

choice_prompt:13:1523403010.text: As food, its only merits are that it's filling and non-toxic. Nothing more.
choice_prompt:13:1523403010.source_cn: 作为食物来说，它的可取之处是无毒，以及能填饱肚子。仅此而已。
choice_prompt:13:1523403010.male: As food, its only merits are that it's filling and non-toxic. Nothing more.
choice_prompt:13:1523403010.female: As food, its only merits are that it's filling and non-toxic. Nothing more.

say:14:1523403011:1.text: Is it really that bad? Seeing the look of disgust on Bakis' face, curiosity gets the better of you, and you decide to taste it for yourself.
say:14:1523403011:1.source_cn: 真有那么难吃？看着比博略显扭曲的表情，你心生好奇，决定...
say:14:1523403011:1.male: Is it really that bad? Seeing the look of disgust on Bakis' face, curiosity gets the better of you, and you decide to taste it for yourself.
say:14:1523403011:1.female: Is it really that bad? Seeing the look of disgust on Bakis' face, curiosity gets the better of you, and you decide to taste it for yourself.

say:15:1523403012:0.text: You put some dough into your mouth and start chewing. An indescribable flavor fills your mouth. Beneath the overwhelming bitterness, you can even detect a faint hint of sourness.
say:15:1523403012:0.source_cn: 你将手中的面团塞进了嘴里，小心地咀嚼起来。
say:15:1523403012:0.male: You put some dough into your mouth and start chewing. An indescribable flavor fills your mouth. Beneath the overwhelming bitterness, you can even detect a faint hint of sourness.
say:15:1523403012:0.female: You put some dough into your mouth and start chewing. An indescribable flavor fills your mouth. Beneath the overwhelming bitterness, you can even detect a faint hint of sourness.

say:16:1523403013:1.text: You've tasted despair, and it's surprisingly grainy.
say:16:1523403013:1.source_cn: 一股难以言喻的味道在你口腔中弥散开来。苦涩两字已无法形...
say:16:1523403013:1.male: You've tasted despair, and it's surprisingly grainy.
say:16:1523403013:1.female: You've tasted despair, and it's surprisingly grainy.

say:17:1523403014:1.text: Bakis hands you a glass of water just in time.
say:17:1523403014:1.source_cn: 幸好，比博及时为你递上了一杯水。
say:17:1523403014:1.male: Bakis hands you a glass of water just in time.
say:17:1523403014:1.female: Bakis hands you a glass of water just in time.

say:18:1523403015:1.text: Now you know I wasn't exaggerating.
say:18:1523403015:1.source_cn: 看来你也认同我的观点。
say:18:1523403015:1.male: Now you know I wasn't exaggerating.
say:18:1523403015:1.female: Now you know I wasn't exaggerating.

say:19:1523403017:1.text: Further modifications are needed, but the thing is, there aren't any herbalists in Halia.
say:19:1523403017:1.source_cn: 这批苦苞穗的种子还需要进一步改良。眼下的问题是，呼临城...
say:19:1523403017:1.male: Further modifications are needed, but the thing is, there aren't any herbalists in Halia.
say:19:1523403017:1.female: Further modifications are needed, but the thing is, there aren't any herbalists in Halia.

say:20:1523403018:1.text: Even if we could find one, it'd take ages for the experiments to show results.
say:20:1523403018:1.source_cn: 即使能够找到这样的学者，也不知道要花费多长时间才能完成...
say:20:1523403018:1.male: Even if we could find one, it'd take ages for the experiments to show results.
say:20:1523403018:1.female: Even if we could find one, it'd take ages for the experiments to show results.

say:21:1523403019:1.text: We don't have the luxury of waiting with Aurelin breathing down our necks...
say:21:1523403019:1.source_cn: 相比之下，奥勒留的抗议和逼迫已近在眼前……
say:21:1523403019:1.male: We don't have the luxury of waiting with Aurelin breathing down our necks...
say:21:1523403019:1.female: We don't have the luxury of waiting with Aurelin breathing down our necks...

say:22:1523403020:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need a favor from you.
say:22:1523403020:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need a favor from you.
say:22:1523403020:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need a favor from you.

say:23:1523403021:1.text: I know you enchanted wheat for the Wildborn to increase its yield.
say:23:1523403021:1.source_cn: 我知道你为雅库伯尔的麦穗施加了魔法，令它可以丰收。
say:23:1523403021:1.male: I know you enchanted wheat for the Wildborn to increase its yield.
say:23:1523403021:1.female: I know you enchanted wheat for the Wildborn to increase its yield.

say:24:1523403022:1.text: Is it possible to modify the bitter corn through magic?
say:24:1523403022:1.source_cn: 那么，通过魔法，能否直接完成苦苞穗的改良？
say:24:1523403022:1.male: Is it possible to modify the bitter corn through magic?
say:24:1523403022:1.female: Is it possible to modify the bitter corn through magic?

say:25:1523403023:1.text: You search through your hazy memories. As far as you know, harvest magic doesn't alter plants, and no other spell comes to mind that could do the job.
say:25:1523403023:1.source_cn: 你在你不甚清晰的记忆里搜索了一番，丰收魔法对作物应该没...
say:25:1523403023:1.male: You search through your hazy memories. As far as you know, harvest magic doesn't alter plants, and no other spell comes to mind that could do the job.
say:25:1523403023:1.female: You search through your hazy memories. As far as you know, harvest magic doesn't alter plants, and no other spell comes to mind that could do the job.

say:26:1523403024:1.text: After weighing everything, you decide to <style="highlight">detect the magic on the bitter corn</style> first.
say:26:1523403024:1.source_cn: 鉴于这种种原因，你决定先<style=highligh...
say:26:1523403024:1.male: After weighing everything, you decide to <style="highlight">detect the magic on the bitter corn</style> first.
say:26:1523403024:1.female: After weighing everything, you decide to <style="highlight">detect the magic on the bitter corn</style> first.

choice_prompt:27:1523403024.text: After weighing everything, you decide to <style="highlight">detect the magic on the bitter corn</style> first.
choice_prompt:27:1523403024.source_cn: 鉴于这种种原因，你决定先<style=highlight>探测一下苦苞穗上的魔力</style>，再做考量。
choice_prompt:27:1523403024.male: After weighing everything, you decide to <style="highlight">detect the magic on the bitter corn</style> first.
choice_prompt:27:1523403024.female: After weighing everything, you decide to <style="highlight">detect the magic on the bitter corn</style> first.

say:28:1523403025:1.text: Given the situation, we have to explore every possible avenue.
say:28:1523403025:1.source_cn: 我明白。现在的境况……只能尽可能尝试各种方法。
say:28:1523403025:1.male: Given the situation, we have to explore every possible avenue.
say:28:1523403025:1.female: Given the situation, we have to explore every possible avenue.

choice:27:0:1.text: Let me take a look at it first.
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 我要先检查一下这些苦苞穗
choice:27:0:1.male: Let me take a look at it first.
choice:27:0:1.female: Let me take a look at it first.

choice:27:1:2.text: I'll have a crack at it.
choice:27:1:2.male: I'll have a crack at it.
choice:27:1:2.female: I'll have a crack at it.

choice:2:0:1.text: Why? The crops seem to be growing just fine.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 为什么？看起来种子结穗了
choice:2:0:1.male: Why? The crops seem to be growing just fine.
choice:2:0:1.female: Why? The crops seem to be growing just fine.

choice:2:1:2.text: Anything wrong with the bitter corn?
choice:2:1:2.male: Anything wrong with the bitter corn?
choice:2:1:2.female: Anything wrong with the bitter corn?

narration:1:1523404001:0.text: You feel the magic in the bitter corn and analyze its composition.
narration:1:1523404001:0.source_cn: 经过一番探测，你终于成功解明了眼前这株苦苞穗的魔力构成
narration:1:1523404001:0.male: You feel the magic in the bitter corn and analyze its composition.
narration:1:1523404001:0.female: You feel the magic in the bitter corn and analyze its composition.

narration:2:1523404002:0.text: Unfortunately, your magic can only improve its yield, but not its quality.
narration:2:1523404002:0.source_cn: 很遗憾，你的魔法只能令它丰收，无法改善它本身的品质
narration:2:1523404002:0.male: Unfortunately, your magic can only improve its yield, but not its quality.
narration:2:1523404002:0.female: Unfortunately, your magic can only improve its yield, but not its quality.

say:5:1523404004:1.text: ... Got it. I should have known better than to take shortcuts in academic research...
say:5:1523404004:1.source_cn: ……我明白了。妄图在学术研究中寻找捷径，果然不会有好结...
say:5:1523404004:1.male: ... Got it. I should have known better than to take shortcuts in academic research...
say:5:1523404004:1.female: ... Got it. I should have known better than to take shortcuts in academic research...

choice_prompt:6:1523404004.text: ... Got it. I should have known better than to take shortcuts in academic research...
choice_prompt:6:1523404004.source_cn: ……我明白了。妄图在学术研究中寻找捷径，果然不会有好结果……罢了，罢了。
choice_prompt:6:1523404004.male: ... Got it. I should have known better than to take shortcuts in academic research...
choice_prompt:6:1523404004.female: ... Got it. I should have known better than to take shortcuts in academic research...

say:7:1523404005:1.text: We should <style="highlight">head back and report to the Regulus</style> first. Let's hope his decree can help find suitable scholars who know what to do with the bitter corn.
say:7:1523404005:1.source_cn: 先<style=highlight>回去向阿邦德殿下汇...
say:7:1523404005:1.male: We should <style="highlight">head back and report to the Regulus</style> first. Let's hope his decree can help find suitable scholars who know what to do with the bitter corn.
say:7:1523404005:1.female: We should <style="highlight">head back and report to the Regulus</style> first. Let's hope his decree can help find suitable scholars who know what to do with the bitter corn.

choice:4:0:1.text: Well, I can only improve the yield...
choice:4:0:1.male: Well, I can only improve the yield...
choice:4:0:1.female: Well, I can only improve the yield...

say:3:1523408002:1.text: Regulus, don't let Aurelin's nonsense get to you.
say:3:1523408002:1.source_cn: 殿下，您不必忧愁，更不必听信奥勒留的胡言。

say:4:1523408003:1.text: The guards should have stopped this. I'll make sure they're punished for their negligence.
say:4:1523408003:1.source_cn: 这次想必是护卫失责，才让他找到机会来您面前说三道四，我...

say:5:1523408004:1.text: No, please don't punish the guards. They aren't at fault.
say:5:1523408004:1.source_cn: 不，不要责罚他们。护卫没有错。

say:6:1523408005:1.text: ... I ordered them to let Aurelin in.
say:6:1523408005:1.source_cn: ……是我下令，让他们不要阻拦奥勒留的。

say:8:1523408007:1.text: I can't just rely on your account to understand their demands.
say:8:1523408007:1.source_cn: 他们抗议了这么久，我不能只通过老师您的转述来了解他们的主张。

say:9:1523408008:1.text: I need to know... whether my decision to sign the agreement is really so dishonorable.
say:9:1523408008:1.source_cn: 我想知道，我签署的停战合约真的有那么不堪吗……

say:10:1523408009:1.text: Is it wrong to compromise temporarily for the sake of peace and survival?
say:10:1523408009:1.source_cn: 为了和平和生存，暂时妥协，难道是错的吗？

say:11:1523408010:1.text: I'm not sure... Could my father have chosen the wrong person to be his successor...
say:11:1523408010:1.source_cn: 我不知道……就像我也不知道，父亲要我继承领主之位，是不...

say:13:1523408012:1.text: ... Whatever the circumstances, please never doubt your father and lose faith in yourself.
say:13:1523408012:1.source_cn: ……无论如何，请您不要说这样的话。不要质疑赫伦尼殿下，...

say:14:1523408013:1.text: You have my support, and that of many fellow councilmen. Contrary to Aurelin's assertion, our backing is not merely out of loyalty to your family.
say:14:1523408013:1.source_cn: 我，还有更多议事官，我们支持您，并不像奥勒留口中所说那...

say:15:1523408014:1.text: You used your own personal wealth to aid the flood victims, let the homeless shelter and rest inside the palace, and met the Wildborn alone to end the war...
say:15:1523408014:1.source_cn: 您用自己的私产赈灾，允许无家可归的人们进入宫殿内避雨休...

say:16:1523408015:1.source_cn: 您所做过的每一件事，我们都看在眼里。

say:17:1523408016:1.text: Your strategies and plans may not yet be mature, but every time you introduce a policy, you put the people's interests first—and that's commendable.
say:17:1523408016:1.source_cn: 固然，您的思维仍稍显稚嫩，策略与计划确实有许多不足。但...

say:18:1523408017:1.text: Halia now needs a ruler who can truly empathize with the people's sufferings.
say:18:1523408017:1.source_cn: 如今的呼临城需要一位能真正体察民众苦难的领主，才能从伤...

say:19:1523408018:1.text: That person can only be you.

say:20:1523408019:1.source_cn: 真……真的吗？\n可是奥勒留他们都说……

say:21:1523408020:1.text: Aurelin's protests have thrown the city into disarray, but you managed to restore order by deploying your personal guards.
say:21:1523408020:1.source_cn: 奥勒留为了抗议，集结士兵终日游行，导致呼临城内秩序不稳...

say:22:1523408021:1.text: This alone proves he doesn't truly care for the people. As a leader, he's far inferior to you.
say:22:1523408021:1.source_cn: 仅凭这一点就能看出，他并不能做到真正为民众考虑，远不如您。

say:23:1523408022:1.text: This isn't just my opinion. Your guards, the people you have helped, and those who haven't been swayed by Aurelin think so too.
say:23:1523408022:1.source_cn: 这不止是我一人的观点。所有您的护卫，所有受过您恩典的民...

choice_prompt:24:1523408022.text: This isn't just my opinion. Your guards, the people you have helped, and those who haven't been swayed by Aurelin think so too.
choice_prompt:24:1523408022.source_cn: 这不止是我一人的观点。所有您的护卫，所有受过您恩典的民众，所有还未被奥勒留蛊惑的人们，都是这样想的。

say:25:1523408023:1.text: ... I think I get it now.

say:26:1523408024:1.text: I can't throw in the towel now; that would just play right into Aurelin's hands.
say:26:1523408024:1.source_cn: 我不能再垂头丧气的了，否则只会让奥勒留的计谋得逞，引得...

say:27:1523408025:0.text: Master Bakis, how are the bitter corn crops coming along? Are they fit to be eaten?
say:27:1523408025:0.source_cn: 比博老师，苦苞穗的种植情况怎么样？能不能直接作为食物？

say:28:1523408026:1.text: We were just about to brief you on this matter...
say:28:1523408026:1.source_cn: 我正要向您汇报这件事……

narration:29:1523408027:1.text: Bakis explains the problems related to the bitter corns to Abundius.

narration:30:1523408028:1.text: And proposes to <style="highlight">recruit scholars to continue Paeon's work</style>.

say:32:1523408030:1.text: I'll issue a decree right away for the recruitment.
say:32:1523408030:1.source_cn: 我这就颁布命令，在城内寻找研究植物的学者。

say:33:1523408031:1.text: We can also dispatch teams to seek help from nearby towns.
say:33:1523408031:1.source_cn: 也可以派人向周围的城邦寻求帮助。

say:35:1523408033:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll get in touch once we find scholars who fit the bill.
say:35:1523408033:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll get in touch once we find scholars who fit the bill.
say:35:1523408033:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'll get in touch once we find scholars who fit the bill.

say:36:1523408034:1.text: Thank you for everything you've done for Halia.
say:36:1523408034:1.source_cn: 感谢你为呼临城所做的一切。
say:36:1523408034:1.male: Thank you for everything you've done for Halia.
say:36:1523408034:1.female: Thank you for everything you've done for Halia.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1523405001:.source_cn: 你该听听呼临人的呼声

cinematic_dialogue:2:1523405002:.text: Do us all a favor and step down!

say:6:1523406001:0.text: How dare you show such insolence before the Regulus!
say:6:1523406001:0.source_cn: 奥勒留，你在殿下面前竟还敢如此狂悖！

say:7:1523406002:1.text: You will apologize to the Regulus at once, and not utter another word!
say:7:1523406002:1.source_cn: 还不快向殿下谢罪，然后闭紧你的嘴！

say:8:1523406003:1.text: Apologize? I didn't do anything wrong!

say:9:1523406004:1.text: I'm merely doing my duty as a councilman by proposing a solution.
say:9:1523406004:1.source_cn: 我是在为领主殿下出谋划策，提供解决方法，履行身为议事官...

say:10:1523406005:1.text: Stop protecting the Regulus like he's some helpless lamb! It's about time he learns how politics works.
say:10:1523406005:1.source_cn: 别再像护着一只小羊羔似的护着殿下了，他早该懂得政治了。

say:11:1523406006:1.text: Since he refuses to face the voices of dissent, it falls upon me to deliver the people's outcry to him myself.
say:11:1523406006:1.source_cn: 他不愿面对抗议，以为捂着耳朵那些声音就不存在，那我只能...

say:12:1523406007:1.text: Drop the sanctimonious act already! I know exactly what you're after!
say:12:1523406007:1.source_cn: 别想用这些冠冕堂皇的空话来掩饰你的目的！

say:13:1523406008:1.text: Deliver the people's outcry? Hmph, that's just your excuse to push for abdication!
say:13:1523406008:1.source_cn: 传达呼临民众的呼声？哼，你不过是在威胁殿下，想以此逼迫...

say:15:1523406010:1.text: You're right—I want him to step down.
say:15:1523406010:1.source_cn: 没错，我就是要让他退位。

say:16:1523406011:1.text: That's the only way the truce agreement can be annulled. We don't want to live at the Wildborn's mercy!
say:16:1523406011:1.source_cn: 只有如此才能撕毁停战合约。只有如此，才能让呼临走向不受...

say:17:1523406012:1.text: You're being absurd! Regulus Abundius is the only rightful ruler of Halia!
say:17:1523406012:1.source_cn: 满口胡言！阿邦德殿下是呼临城唯一的继承人！

say:18:1523406013:1.text: As long as Regulus Abundius lives, the throne is his and his alone!
say:18:1523406013:1.source_cn: 过去、现在、未来——只要阿邦德殿下还在，领主之位就只能...

say:19:1523406014:1.text: You're too narrow-minded, thinking wheat is our only food source.
say:19:1523406014:1.source_cn: 你拥兵自重，张扬抗议，是因为你太狭隘，认为呼临城的食物...

say:20:1523406015:1.text: Your arguments will collapse once the Regulus secures other sources!
say:20:1523406015:1.source_cn: 等到殿下寻得其他食物的那天，你演说的这些观点，便会不攻自破！

say:21:1523406016:1.text: What else can we use to make food besides wheat? I hope your solution doesn't involve begging for the fallen god's mercy.
say:21:1523406016:1.source_cn: 食物？除了小麦，你还要从哪里寻找食物？该不会是走投无路...

say:22:1523406017:1.text: Your efforts are futile, Bakis. Look at yourself, relying on an outsider for salvation... What's the point of defending the so-called "legitimate" regime? Is it more important than Halia's future?!
say:22:1523406017:1.source_cn: 别再做无用的挣扎了。都已经无能到要向外人求救……你所坚...
say:22:1523406017:1.male: Your efforts are futile, Bakis. Look at yourself, relying on an outsider for salvation... What's the point of defending the so-called "legitimate" regime? Is it more important than Halia's future?!
say:22:1523406017:1.female: Your efforts are futile, Bakis. Look at yourself, relying on an outsider for salvation... What's the point of defending the so-called "legitimate" regime? Is it more important than Halia's future?!

say:23:1523406018:1.text: Exploring alternative food sources can only benefit the people!
say:23:1523406018:1.source_cn: 为呼临城寻找除小麦之外的食物来源，分明是一件只有利处的好事！

say:24:1523406019:1.text: You claim to care about the people, but what have you actually done for them? All I see is bitterness and sarcasm, not out of compassion, but just to prop up your own arguments.
say:24:1523406019:1.source_cn: 你口口声声说为了呼临城、为了民众，却又对此毫不关心，甚...

say:25:1523406020:1.text: Aurelin, your arrogance blinds you! If you persist in this folly, Halia will pay the price!
say:25:1523406020:1.source_cn: 奥勒留，你太狂妄了！你再这样固执己见，继续争斗，只会给...

say:27:1523406022:1.text: Seems like you've made up your mind to carry your foolish devotion all the way, huh?
say:27:1523406022:1.source_cn: 看来你是打定主意，要将你那愚忠贯彻到底了！

say:28:1523406023:1.text: Foolish or not, that's not for you to decide.
say:28:1523406023:1.source_cn: 我是否愚忠，不是你说了算。

say:29:1523406024:1.text: Hmph, so be it. Don't expect me to go easy on you next time.
say:29:1523406024:1.source_cn: 哼。既然如此，那就别怪我不留情面。

narration:34:15050415:0.text: Aurelin brazenly pressures Abundius to step down, leaving him at a loss. Just in time, Bakis intervenes and sternly rebukes Aurelin.
narration:34:15050415:0.source_cn: 奥勒留竟然在威胁阿邦德退位，阿邦德一时不知所措，幸好学...
